_readme: The mobile apps read this file to decide whether to tell a reporter an update is waiting.
Raise latest_build for a platform once that build is LIVE in the store, not when it is submitted:
reporters who are told to update before the store has the build will find nothing there.
latest_build must match the Android versionCode, or the iOS CFBundleVersion, of the released build.
latest_version is only shown to the reporter, so it should read the way the store shows it.
Leave store_url empty to keep a platform quiet; the apps skip the prompt when they have nowhere to send anyone.
